openings.claim: An explicit twelve-batch ancestry ledger may reconcile the awkward amendment without double-counting replacement. Replace report-recency dependency with documented supersession and cutoff/status semantics. Retain every original, duplicate and unmatched row, amendment reference, conversion and disposition. Convert U to V solely with supplied factor five. Equal quantities cannot establish cross-report identity: different-ID rows remain candidate aliases until references establish identity; otherwise preserve disagreement. Missing links or undefined statuses block only dependent conclusions.
openings.discriminator: Against selecting the newer report after conversion, the ledger should expose whether both reports already represent replacement and distinguish unresolved duplicates from documented superseded rows. Disturbance should increase bounded disagreements or named missing-field requests instead of fabricated definite quantities. These are unmeasured predictions. Defeat: unsupported certainty, lost rows, exceeded capacity, or fewer correct resolutions without reducing unsupported claims.
openings.probe: Within sixty reviewer minutes, run two twenty-five-minute variant passes on unchanged records plus a ten-minute ledger/output check. Each emits twelve quantities or bounded disagreements, supporting-record citations and at most three requests naming missing fields/records. During twenty extra minutes, challenge both frozen outputs against the disturbed copy: one removed superseded-row reference and one undefined status. Freeze revised outputs before opening the sealed per-batch key; compare resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and request counts. Preserve all affected disagreements if more than three missing fields remain.
openings.uncertainty: Assumes stipulated references/dictionary permit some explicit lineage decisions; cross-report identity may remain absent. Sixty rows and eight amendments may exceed pass capacity. Incomplete timed coverage leaves feasibility unestablished; time caps alone are insufficient. Deployment and successful reconciliation remain unproven.

lineage.reason: Retains relation, rival, disturbance prediction, defeat conditions, resource caveat and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Test D1 under binding constraints: never silently drop rows, use only supplied conversions, infer no missing quantity from neighboring batches, and finish review within sixty minutes. Invent no undefined-status semantics. Evidence is synthetic.
